title: Construction of PLC Cells Stably Overexpressing Csseverin
author: Mengchen Shi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kcdcss6
materials: Supernatant containing the recombinant lentiviral particles was collected at 48 h post-transfection, filtered by a Millipore filter and subjected to ultracentrifugation.

steps.title: Digest vector and insert
steps.instruction: Digest the PEZ‑LV203 vector with EcoRI and the Csseverin gene fragment with ApaI, then ligate the two fragments using T4 DNA ligase.

substeps.instruction: Digest Csseverin gene fragment with ApaI.
Ligate the digested vector and insert with T4 DNA ligase.

steps.title: Verify recombinant plasmid
steps.instruction: Identify the recombinant plasmid pEZ‑LV203‑Csseverin by restriction enzyme digestion and confirm the sequence by DNA sequencing.

steps.title: Produce lentivirus
steps.instruction: Co‑transfect 293T cells with either the pEZ‑LV203‑Csseverin plasmid or the PEZ‑LV203 control plasmid to generate lentiviral particles.

steps.title: Resuspend and infect cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the harvested lentiviral particles in cold phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) and use the suspension to infect PLC cells.

steps.title: Select stable transductants
steps.instruction: 48 hours after infection, culture the PLC cells in selection medium containing puromycin at 3 mg/ml for 7 days to obtain stably overexpressing cells.
